buyer: Beacon Parent Holdings, L.P. (backed by The Carlyle Group and SK Capital Partners)

value_inflection_events.event: Rumored acquisition proposal from PJ Carlin & Co.
Merger Agreement executed and officially announced

leaked_early.details: No evidence of a press report/rumor >= ~1 month prior to official announcement. Buyout rumors only surfaced retrospectively via SEC filings in March 2025.

notes: Company faced a severe liquidity crisis and risk of imminent bankruptcy, which drove a rapid negotiated sale process. The final deal included a CVR providing potential additional value, and a competing bid from Ayrmid eventually led to an amended all-cash alternative option.
